name: Arcturus Defense Solutions NociStrike NS-3 'Flense'
description:
The NociStrike NS-3 is Arcturus Defense Solutions' premier sensory-overload aerosol, engineered around a synthetic nociceptor activation compound designated ADS-NC3 that binds directly to TRPV1 and TRPA1 ion channels across all exposed skin and mucous membrane surfaces simultaneously. Unlike capsaicin derivatives which produce localized burning, ADS-NC3 produces a full-body pain signal — every exposed centimeter of skin fires as though in contact with open flame. The experience has been described in ADS technical documentation as 'distributed acute nociceptive saturation.' In street testimony from Shelf survivors of municipal deployments, it is described as being flayed alive while still breathing.

The NS-3 is packaged in a matte-black reinforced canister with a recessed trigger guard and a 180-degree adjustable nozzle allowing for either targeted stream or 60-degree fan dispersal. The compound is oil-suspended, meaning it adheres to skin and clothing rather than dissipating, sustaining effect for twenty to forty-five minutes unless treated with the Arcturus-licensed neutralizing rinse (ADS-NR3). Decontamination with water alone spreads the oil and worsens the effect — a fact that municipal deployment manuals note as a 'compliance-extending feature.'

The NS-3 has been the subject of three separate Meridian Council review hearings following documented cases of subjects with compromised dermal augmentation suffering permanent nerve damage. Arcturus has successfully argued each time that such outcomes fall within acceptable parameters for a less-lethal instrument, and the product remains in active municipal contract.
legality: Licensed — law enforcement and licensed security; civilian possession restricted
specifications:
Active compound: ADS-NC3 (TRPV1/TRPA1 agonist, oil-suspended)
Delivery: stream (effective 4m) or 60-degree fan (effective 2m)
Onset: 1–3 seconds
Duration of effect: 20–45 minutes without neutralizer
Canister capacity: 8 bursts
Weight: 0.24 kg
Dimensions: 16cm × 5cm
Neutralizer: ADS-NR3 rinse required for decontamination
Price: Φ220
tactical_use: The NS-3 is deployed in riot control and forced-entry scenarios where immediate and total compliance is required. Security teams use it in breaching operations — a burst through a doorway before entry clears the room of resistance without requiring lethal engagement. It is also used in hostage-adjacent situations where standard OC might be insufficient against subjects with pain-dampening augmentation, as ADS-NC3 bypasses most standard nerve-filter chrome by activating channels that augmentation typically leaves unmodified. Trained operators always carry ADS-NR3 neutralizer to manage their own potential exposure.
cultural_context: The NS-3 has acquired the street name 'Flense' — to strip skin — and 'Liquid Agony' is used almost universally in Shelf and Tier 2 communities to describe it. It occupies a specific cultural register of fear: not the fear of a bullet, which is clean, but the fear of prolonged helpless suffering. Graffiti in Shelf districts sometimes depicts a figure dissolving under the phrase 'ADS loves you.' Augmented individuals with dermal chrome modifications are particularly anxious about it, as even legal chrome cannot fully protect against nerve channel activation.
story_hooks: A canister of NS-3 was used in a residential block clearance that wasn't authorized — someone needs to find out who ordered it and why before the evidence disappears
related_entities: Carrion Defense Works Neural Lash NL-3 'Agony'

physical_description.visual_profile: A compact, brutalist canister with the aggressive stance of a less-lethal enforcement tool. The form is utilitarian and deliberately intimidating—a cylinder that reads as 'pain in a can.' No curves, no marketing softness. Pure function.
physical_description.dimensions: 16cm height × 5cm diameter. Compact enough to ride a duty belt or fit in a reinforced holster. Proportionally dense.
physical_description.weight_description: Substantial for its size. 240 grams—heavy enough to feel purposeful in the hand, but not cumbersome. The weight sits forward in the palm when gripped, giving the sense of a directed payload.
physical_description.primary_material: Reinforced polymer composite with steel internal pressure vessel. The casing is blast-rated to prevent rupture under thermal stress or impact.
physical_description.finish: Matte black powder coat—non-reflective, tactical, designed to absorb rather than shine. Surface shows micro-texturing to prevent light reflection. Purposefully absent of chrome or gloss.
physical_description.color_scheme: Primary: charcoal matte black. Accents: cold steel gray on pressure seal ring and nozzle head. Minimal branding in recessed lettering (gunmetal gray).
physical_description.grip_texture: Rubberized polymer with aggressive knurling in the palm grip area. Slightly tacky to discourage slipping during wet or high-stress deployment. Grip extends from mid-canister to base.
distinctive_features: Recessed trigger guard—molded inset to prevent accidental discharge and indicate controlled activation
180-degree adjustable nozzle articulating from canister head—allows rotation between stream (narrow, 4m effective) and 60-degree fan spray (2m effective)
Pressure relief valve visible as small recessed dot on upper canister body
Serial number and batch code etched in microscopic lettering on lower third (Arcturus/Blackwood corporate compliance)
Nozzle head finished in brushed steel with micro-perforations visible only on close inspection
Safety collar: a rotating lock ring beneath trigger guard bearing faint 'SAFE/LIVE' markings
Faint oil residue visible on nozzle from pressurized compound—perpetually 'loaded'
Wear marks typical on duty models: scuffing on canister walls from holster friction, small dents from impact
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: Arcturus Defense Solutions logo (minimalist geometric A) recessed 2cm from canister top. Below: 'NociStrike NS-3 / ADS-NC3' in sans-serif block lettering. 'BLACKWOOD COMMERCIAL GROUP' stamped near base. Meridian Council licensing mark (circular embossed seal) on opposite side. All markings are recessed or etched to avoid snagging.
physical_description.condition_typical: Field-worn but maintained. Matte finish shows micro-scratches from holster draw-and-secure cycles. Nozzle may show slight discoloration from residual aerosol compound exposure. Overall condition suggests regular deployment and proper maintenance by trained security personnel. Battle-scarred units show impact marks and occasional trigger guard stress marks from high-intensity deployment scenarios.
